speaker: Doctor
text: Dr. Agent: Thank you for coming in. To better understand your condition, have you noticed any specific patterns in the rash, such as blisters, scaling, or changes in color? Additionally, does the numbness or tingling occur only on the palms, or does it extend to your fingers or wrists?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Scabies (infestation by Sarcoptes scabiei)

Your description of a pruritic rash on the upper body and face combined with paresthesia on the palms, especially given your close contact with livestock and farming duties, strongly suggests scabies. Could you confirm if the rash involves the web spaces between your fingers or if you notice any burrow-like lines? Also, have you noticed any similar symptoms or rash in other family members?
